design_philosophy: Quiet, personal, elegant, and not cluttered. Avoid social media style UI, overloaded screens, and harsh contrasts. Zero bright white, zero blue.

interactions.radial_expand: spring out from center of button with 300ms duration, stagger items by 50ms

bottom_nav.structure: Floating pill or soft elevated bottom bar. Avoid harsh top borders.
bottom_nav.active_state: Icon in Primary (#A98C70) with a subtle dot indicator underneath.

quick_action_button.position: Top right of the Home (Chat List) screen header.

radial_action_menu.nodes: 3 to 4 circular floating action nodes appearing in an arc around the button (e.g., New Group, Scan, Voice Memo). Background: #F2EFE9, Icon: #3C352D.

chat_bubble.directional_radius: 4px on the corner connecting to the sender.

voice_message.visual: Horizontal rounded pill (24px radius). Contains a play button and waveform.
voice_message.waveform: Vertical rounded bars. Played portion uses Primary (#A98C70), unplayed uses Border (#E6E1D6).

file_preview_card.layout: Left icon (doc, image, audio) in a soft square, middle is title/size, right is download/view action.
file_preview_card.typography: Title uses body (16px, 500 weight), subtitle uses caption in Text Secondary.

spaces_placeholder.visual: A muted, non-intrusive banner or pill button integrated at the top of a chat or home screen.
spaces_placeholder.style: Dashed or soft border (#E6E1D6), transparent background, Text Secondary color, 16px radius.

auth.layout: Minimalist centered layout. Large Fraunces headline. Smooth inputs with warm border focus states.
auth.inputs: Height 56px, Radius 16px, Bg #F2EFE9, Border transparent (Border Focus #A98C70).

home_chat_list.header: Fraunces H1 'Connect', Quick Action Button on right.
home_chat_list.list_item: Row with Avatar (48px), Name (Body Lg), Preview (Caption). Unread indicator: Soft Primary dot.

files_hub.layout: Segmented control or soft tabs (Recent, By Person, Categories).
files_hub.grid: 2-column bento-style grid for categories (Images, Docs, Audio) with large soft icons.

calls_mock.layout: Centered avatar with soft glowing rings pulsing outward (Shadow Glow). Warm dark overlay for the active call feel.

profile_you.layout: Large avatar, Name. List of settings items grouped in soft cards (Radius 24px, Bg #F2EFE9).

icons.style: Regular or Duotone. Must feel soft and legible.

avatars.description: Young woman with brown hair looking at camera (warm, natural)
A woman with her hand on her face (calm, serene)
Close-up profile of woman in a turtleneck
Close-up of a man sleeping peacefully

textures.description: Abstract beige background with wavy lines

testing.attributes: All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute for robust testing (e.g. data-testid='login-button', data-testid='chat-tab').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React Native View and Text components mapped to the design system rules.
Implement the radial menu via Reanimated or standard React Native Animated API to achieve the 200-300ms spring animations.
Ensure all fonts are loaded correctly (Fraunces and DM Sans or safe fallbacks).
Replace ALL standard white backgrounds (#FFFFFF) with #FBF9F6 and standard blacks (#000000) with #3C352D.
Use Phosphor icons. All icons should share the soft geometry.
For phase 1 MVP, create the static shell of features if backend is not requested.
